messages:
incident-bot: Paging carla (oncall) — elevated 5xx + timeout alerts for /v1/generate across us-west-2. Severity: HIGH. Incident created INC-4321.

carla (oncall): on it, joining. any customer-facing outages yet?

support-bot: Affected: 12 customers seeing 502/504s, spike started ~10:12 UTC. Error rate ~18% for /v1/generate. Latency p95 shot to 6s.

alex (eng-sre): adding context — metric deck shows scheduler queue length rising on pool gpu-p2. head-of-line blocking on large-batch requests. Looks like one model variant is producing long KV cache chains.

maria (runtime): confirmed — batch scheduler backlog grew from ~200 to ~4.5k entries. Many requests stuck waiting for batch fill since smaller requests are behind a few huge-seq requests.

carla (oncall): ok immediate mitigation ideas: 1) throttle/blackhole huge-seq traffic 2) lower max_batch_size on affected pool 3) enable bypass queue for high-priority traffic 4) spin additional scheduler workers if capacity. Which is fastest?

alex (eng-sre): fastest: set batch size cap and enable bypass. I can push a temporary policy to route requests with header X-Priority=high through fast-path (bypass). maria can adjust scheduler config.

maria (runtime): working on config change. patch:
```
# tmp: reduce batch size to 64 from 512 for pool gpu-p2
scheduler.pool.gpu-p2.max_batch_size = 64
scheduler.pool.gpu-p2.bypass_enabled = true
```
Applying on prod now (rolling)

tom (infra): spinning up 4 extra scheduler pods in us-west-2 autoscaling group to help drain backlog. ETA ~3m.

carla (oncall): notify support and customers? escalate to PG?

alex (eng-sre): pinging PG and support. Support message drafted: "We're investigating increased errors/timeouts affecting generation endpoints in us-west-2. Mitigations in progress; will update in 15m."

support-bot: message queued to affected customers.

maria (runtime): rollout applied to 3/6 nodes; backlog dropped from 4.5k -> 900 in 60s. Error rate dropping to ~6%. Continuing rollout.

carla (oncall): good. keep throttles in place until stable. Also need to capture root cause — why large sequences saturated scheduler. alex, can you collect traces and sample requests?

alex (eng-sre): collecting traces now. Early look: a third-party client started sending padded prompts w/ large context, acking no early stop, resulting in huge token counts per request. Many are from customer X and testing scripts.

carla (oncall): action items:
- (maria) finish rollout and confirm p95 < 1s and error rate < 1%
- (tom) keep extra schedulers up for 30m then scale down based on load
- (alex) attach sample request IDs and trace links to INC-4321
- (support) send follow-up to affected customers with ETA

maria (runtime): rollout done. p95 now ~0.9s, error rate 0.8% (last 2m). queue length stabilized ~120.

tom (infra): extra pods are live. will set horizontal autoscaler to prefer higher min for next 30m.

carla (oncall): great. marking incident in progress -> mitigated. leaving mitigations: batch cap + bypass + temporary autoscale. We'll keep incident open for root cause and postmortem.

alex (eng-sre): note: we should add per-client max_sequence_length enforcement and a backpressure signal earlier in the pipeline to avoid H-O-L blocking. Also recommend default smaller batch sizes for pools with mixed seq distribution.

support-bot: Customer update sent: "Mitigations applied; service performance restored to normal. We're investigating root cause (large-context requests) and will follow up with recommended limits and opt-in configs."

carla (oncall): assigning owners for postmortem: alex (cause), maria (mitigation shims), tom (autoscaling tuning), support will coordinate customer comms. I'll do the incident write-up.

incident-bot: INC-4321 status updated: MITIGATED -> POSTMORTEM PENDING.

carla (oncall): switching to handoff to night on-call in 30m. if any regression ping @carla or reopen INC-4321. thanks all :thumbsup:

alex (eng-sre): uploaded traces + request samples to the incident ticket. adding quick mitigation playbook entry:
```
- detect: sudden queue length increase in scheduler.pool.*
- mitigation fast: set max_batch_size=64, enable bypass for X-Priority, spin extra schedulers
- mitigation slow: per-client seq limit, request-side backpressure, alert if queue > 3k
```

maria (runtime): logging and alerts updated to include per-sequence-length histograms. will post follow-up PR with config defaults.

carla (oncall): closing channel for now. will attach postmortem link when ready.

support-bot: Incident INC-4321: MITIGATED. Final metrics: peak error rate 18%, duration 00:42, customers impacted: 12 (no data loss).
